Priya —

Samir Gupta at Lumen is available and a great fit; they've been running a programmatic scoring service with Redwood for ~9 months. Quick notes:
- Typical p50/p95 token-scoring latency (single region, rtx-backed pools): ~18ms / 72ms for 256-dim dense scoring at 1–2k TPS with batching; under multi-region routing p95 goes up to ~95ms but their SLA target is 120ms.
- KV cache: they shard by store region and pre-warm caches using a daily job; during promotions they enable an aggressive prefetch window and bump batch sizes briefly.
- Billing patterns: they buy reserved capacity for steady traffic and use burst pools for campaign spikes; unit cost dropped ~26% after we tuned quantization and batching.

Samir told me he can hop on a 30m call Wed 3/16 11:00–11:30 PT or Thu 3/17 09:30–10:00 PT. He is OK with procurement being on the call.

Emma at ShopWave is a secondary option but asks to limit operational details (prefers high-level).

I attached the brief I usually send ahead of calls.
